MERP Systems, Inc. (MERP) is an IT services organization that specialize in business applications modernization and digital transformation consulting services. MERP has developed a center of excellence that provides Federal, State & Local, and Nonprofit customers a technology strategy and systems development support using Microsoft Power Apps (Model View & Canvas Apps), Dynamics 365, and SharePoint. MERP, a CMMI Level 3 appraised enterprise, is also a GOLD certified Microsoft Partner.

Reach out today at KMaloney@merpsystems.com to learn more about how MERP Systems can help with your digital transformation!
